		 Subject: Document Retention Policy

Christian:  We have learned from Stephen Patterson that you are in the process of updating Credit_Risk's document retention policy.  What will the policy be with regard to retaining drafts of agreements after a particular transaction has closed?  It is our understanding that Credit_Risk's current policy is to discard all drafts post-closing.   We are in the process of formalizing our own document retention policy, and want to ensure that our practices line up with Credit_Risk's. Please advise.  Mandy (Corporate_Lending Legal)
